one_sentence: This document argues that ten physical laws each contain both constructive and destructive spiritual expressions within the same equation, with Free Will as the differentiating variable.
executive_summary: This document presents a unified framework mapping ten fundamental physics laws to spiritual principles, asserting that each law (except Laws 9 and 10) contains both grace and corruption within the same equation. Free Will (W) is introduced as the variable differentiating spiritual from physical systems. Shannon Information Theory serves as the measurement layer, making all laws testable. Laws 1-8 are internally dual, while Law 9 (Adversary) is one-directional downward and Law 10 (Christ) is one-directional upward, acting as two attractors. The framework is supported by convergence data from three independent AIs and a Bible-first derivation. The document concludes with a salvation algorithm derived from first principles and a sequence showing how the laws interlock in the salvation process.
short_summary: This document is a canonical framework synthesizing ten physical laws with spiritual principles. The core structural claim is that each law contains both constructive and destructive regimes within the same equation, with Free Will as the differentiating variable. Key evidence includes convergence data from three independent AIs and a Bible-first derivation showing 10-for-10 overlap with physics-derived variables. This matters because it provides a testable, mathematically grounded framework for understanding spiritual realities through physical laws.
